name: Ecosystem Map
description: A semantic map of projects, packages, docs, and relationships.

accessibility.semantics: Use native semantic elements in Ecosystem Map templates before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Interactive descendants must be reachable by keyboard and expose visible focus.
notes: Color is never the only communication channel.
Motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion where animation exists.

responsive.strategy: Intrinsic layout with logical properties, responsive grids, and container queries where useful.

examples.name: Standalone
examples.notes: Consumer-authored reference, no automatic prop binding. Prefix IDs before repeating.

binding.html: article children with heading, content and optional links

items.contract: Authored data structure: label is displayed text; content is escaped text or trusted authored slot markup. Optional href is a consumer-owned safe navigation URL. No automatic renderer.

binding.html: visible prose or list of links identifying node relationships; no graph engine

items.contract: Authored data structure: label is displayed text; content is escaped text or trusted authored slot markup. Optional href is a consumer-owned safe navigation URL. No automatic renderer.

binding.html: textContent or accessible name appropriate to the element

items.contract: Consumer data. Render labels as text and content through the documented semantic child/slot structure; never insert untrusted HTML.

grid.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

radial.notes: Legacy alias of the semantic node grid. No radial positioning or graph engine is supplied.

compact.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

guidance.use: Display ecosystem nodes as a responsive grid of authored cards.
guidance.avoid: A force graph, radial layout engine or relationship visualization.

nodes.content: Trusted authored semantic HTML; preserve child structure in example.html. Text data must be escaped.

relationships.content: Trusted authored semantic HTML; preserve child structure in example.html. Text data must be escaped.
